meta.about: Coloured lighting at the tops of the Canary Wharf towers: what the sources say about how a colour is chosen, the campaigns with dates, and a dated list of observations (press, social posts, open photos, the owner's photos). Facts in our own words; no page text or image is copied. Colours named by hand; hex values are approximate (measured from a photo where 'measured' says so, else a reference colour of the campaign).
meta.by: hand, from web searches, the press and Commons lists made by tools/fetch-crown-lighting.mjs (press-pages.json, commons-photos.json) and the owner's photos of 3 October 2026

buildings.cwb-0451: Newfoundland (Q15917518): crown of triangular panels lit warm white
buildings.cwb-0582: 25 Bank Street (Q138752): RGB LED crown installed 2004

meta.colour_hex_rule: hex is approximate. 'measured' = mean of the brightest 20% of pixels (30% for dim pyramids) in the lit area of a thumbnail or the owner's photo; camera white balance and night processing shift it. 'reference' = the campaign's published or usual colour, not seen.
meta.history_note: No public register or schedule of colours was found (2026-10-04). The list below is a sample: press releases and partner news for some campaigns, and photos on the nights someone uploaded one. Do not fill gaps between dates.

facts: the pyramid has a permanent system of about a thousand electronically controlled fluorescent tubes that can be sequence-programmed for occasions and festive seasons (its reference 37)
the pyramid holds a flashing aircraft warning light, rare in the UK
lights and lasers were installed for Christmas 1991
the pyramid lights up in the evenings with about 4,000 energy-efficient lamps, visible up to 20 miles away; the beacon at the top is separate
for Christmas 1996 the pyramid was lit green by a temporary 400 kW rig of PAR-64 lamps with Lee 122 Fern Green filters (design Simon Corder, producer Simon Byford)

the apex light is a high-intensity white flashing obstacle light, not the usual steady red, because the tower is near London City Airport under its extended runway centreline; an aeronautical study during planning (1991) required it (CAA CAP 168)
xenon high-intensity warning lights replaced by four WL-100 white high-intensity LED aircraft warning lights in November 2012

25 Bank Street (then Lehman Brothers' HQ2) got an LED crown of 152 Solar M200B RGB fixtures on ETC Unison control; green and blue colour-mixing sequences at set intervals; design LightMatters, supply and programming A.C. Lighting
8 Canada Square's HSBC signs were replaced in late 2014 by LED signs that look black by day and white at night
Connected by Light, 2 December 2020 to 27 February 2021, dusk to 22:00: 'Newfoundland Reflections' by Hawthorn lit the Newfoundland tower in changing colours

no public request form, policy, criteria or calendar for lighting One Canada Square was found on CWG pages, in press or in search results; partner organisations (charities, the council, TfL) appear in each case

pattern_notes: Open photos of 2012 to 2018 show the pyramid faces lit cool white at 20:28 to 22:29; one photographer's series on 2013-06-13 shows no white pyramid from 23:00 (dim red tone). The owner's photo at 23:56 on 2026-10-03 shows dark faces and a red band. A switch-off or a change of scene near 23:00 would fit, but four nights are not evidence of a schedule.
Campaign colours are sampled only where a press page, partner page or post exists: nine campaigns from 1991 to 2025, five of them since 2021.
gaps: No CWG lighting calendar, request form or criteria found.
